summary_rationale: Vertex Pharmaceuticals earns COMPOUNDER_PASS on its near-monopoly Cystic Fibrosis franchise (~$11.8B FY2025 revenue, 86.2% GAAP gross margin, 34.8% operating margin, $3.19B FCF, and near-flat 10-year diluted share count), reinforced by Alyftrek's rapid uptake ($706M Q3 2026) which extends core CF patents to 2039 and cuts CFF royalties by paying only on its 1/3 tezacaftor share. KPI health is PASS_WITH_WATCH because non-CF diversification—Casgevy ($99M Q3 2026, ATC capacity & 60/40 CRISPR split), Journavx ($58M Q3 2026, LSR setback & PBM friction), povetacicept (Nov 30, 2026 PDUFA; Asia licensed to Zai Lab/Ono), and Crinetics ($10.0B deal adding $8.52B intangibles with $5.12B atumelnant IPR&D impairment overhang and a $4.5B floating-rate SOFR term loan due 2027–2029)—must scale alongside 2027 Kalydeco/Symdeko patent expiries, 34% McKesson/Accredo customer concentration, and the Jan 2027 CFO transition to Jonathan Poole.
